meta.title: 科学解释人眼动态模糊和180度快门的关系
meta.title_en: Scientifically Explaining the Human-Eye Motion Blur & the 180° Shutter Rule

scenes.title_cn: 开场：出于艺术的考量，感光度、光圈我…
scenes.title_en: Opening: for artistic reasons we can't tou…
sentences: 出于艺术的考量，感光度、光圈我们都不可以调。
For artistic reasons, we can't touch ISO or aperture.
artistic reasons（艺术考量）
那为何快门也不能调呢？简单的回答就是180度原则。
Why not the shutter? The simple answer is the 180-degree rule.
180-degree rule（180度原则）
scenes.speak: For artistic reasons, we can't touch ISO or aperture. Why not the shutter? The simple answer is the 180-degree rule.

scenes.title_cn: 拍照片与拍视频的区别：咱们拍照片的时…
scenes.title_en: Photo vs video: when shooting photos in di…
scenes.context: 照片可调快门，视频却犯大忌。
sentences: 咱们拍照片的时候，如果画面太暗，我们最直觉的反应就是减慢快门。
In photos, dim light triggers the instinct to slow the shutter.
intuitive fix（直觉反应）
但一旦到了拍视频，调节快门可是犯了大忌。
But in video, touching the shutter is a big taboo.
big taboo（犯大忌）
电影的快门速度只有一个，那就是48分之1秒。
Film has only one shutter speed: 1/48s.
one shutter speed（唯一快门）
scenes.speak: In photos, dim light triggers the instinct to slow the shutter. But in video, touching the shutter is a big taboo. Film has only one shutter speed: 1/48s.

scenes.title_cn: 人眼帧率是动态的：大伙都知道电影作品…
scenes.title_en: The eye's frame rate is dynamic: everyone …
sentences: 电影作品的帧率为24帧，每秒钟快速播放24张图片，让大脑支出连贯动感的错觉。
Film runs at 24fps—24 images per second trick the brain into motion.
24fps illusion（24帧错觉）
很多朋友误以为人眼的帧率也是24帧，其实这是错误的。
Many think the eye's frame rate is also 24fps—that's wrong.
not 24fps（不是24帧）
人眼的帧率完全取决于你的注意力和生命机能。
The eye's frame rate depends on your attention and biological function.
dynamic attention（动态注意）
电竞选手可以分辨144Hz和240Hz显示器高刷的区别。
Esports players can tell 144Hz from 240Hz monitors.
high refresh（高刷）
scenes.speak: Film runs at 24fps—24 images per second trick the brain into motion. Many think the eye's frame rate is also 24fps—that's wrong. The eye's frame rate depends on your attention and biological function. Esports players can tell 144Hz from 240Hz monitors.

scenes.title_cn: 视觉暂留与实验：光线通过晶体成像落在…
scenes.title_en: Persistence of vision and an experiment: l…
scenes.context: 视觉暂留造成拖影，强光拖影更长。
sentences: 感光细胞产生的化学信号不会瞬间消失，大概会持续10分之1到15分之1秒。
Photoreceptor signals don't vanish instantly—they persist 1/10 to 1/15 of a second.
persist briefly（短暂持续）
大脑会合成这段时间内光所发生的所有变化成为一段快照，被称之为视觉暂留。
The brain composites all changes into one snapshot—persistence of vision.
persistence of vision（视觉暂留）
手电筒的光造成更强的刺激，感光细胞需要更长时间恢复敏感度。
Stronger light means photoreceptors take longer to recover sensitivity.
stronger stimulus（更强刺激）
人类可以根据这条拖影轨迹判断物体从哪个方向来，预测将要往哪个方向去。
We use the trail to judge direction and predict movement.
judge direction（判断方向）
scenes.speak: Photoreceptor signals don't vanish instantly—they persist 1/10 to 1/15 of a second. The brain composites all changes into one snapshot—persistence of vision. Stronger light means photoreceptors take longer to recover sensitivity. We use the trail to judge direction and predict movement.

scenes.title_cn: 24帧标准帧率：说回标准帧率，电影工…
scenes.title_en: The 24fps standard: back to the standard f…
sentences: 电影工业默片时期曾建议过使用16帧每秒作为标准帧率。
The silent era once suggested 16fps as the standard.
silent era（默片时期）
设定一个兼容声音画面并且稳定播放的标准帧率，成为了不得不解决的问题。
A rate compatible with sound and picture became a must-solve problem.
sound and picture（声画兼容）
24帧每秒既不是人眼感知动态的极限帧率，也不是能够形成动态错觉的最低帧率。
24fps is neither the eye's limit nor the minimum for motion illusion.
neither limit（非极限）
如果播放的画面过于清晰，人眼能开始觉察到眼前播放的是一张张单独的图片。
Too-sharp frames reveal themselves as individual pictures.
too sharp（过于清晰）
scenes.speak: The silent era once suggested 16fps as the standard. A rate compatible with sound and picture became a must-solve problem. 24fps is neither the eye's limit nor the minimum for motion illusion. Too-sharp frames reveal themselves as individual pictures.

scenes.title_cn: 180度快门：以前的快门是长这样的一…
scenes.title_en: The 180-degree shutter: the old shutter wa…
sentences: 以前的快门是长这样的一个圆盘，镂空的地方是允许每帧画面曝光的时长。
The old shutter was a disc; the cutout allows per-frame exposure.
shutter disc（快门圆盘）
镂空的缝隙越小，代表曝光时长越短，画面越锐利，动态模糊越小。
Smaller cutout, shorter exposure, sharper image, less blur.
sharp but no blur（锐利无糊）
180度快门是人定下的规矩，它是可以打破的。
The 180-degree rule is a human convention—it can be broken.
can be broken（可以打破）
电影人通过提高快门速度，模拟战争现场感。
Filmmakers raise the shutter to simulate the battlefield feel.
battlefield feel（战争现场感）
paraphrase: sharp but no blur（锐利无糊
sharp but no blur（锐利无糊
scenes.speak: The old shutter was a disc; the cutout allows per-frame exposure. Smaller cutout, shorter exposure, sharper image, less blur. The 180-degree rule is a human convention—it can be broken. Filmmakers raise the shutter to simulate the battlefield feel.

scenes.title_cn: 结语：之所以是180度，因为这个原则…
scenes.context: 180度是工业遗产形成的视觉烙印。
sentences: 这个原则是工业历史的遗产，而电影标准被沿用了100多年。
It's an industrial legacy used for over a hundred years.
industrial legacy（工业遗产）
已经在人类文明基因中形成视觉烙印，我们本能认为这就是电影感。
A visual imprint in the culture—we instinctively feel this is cinema.
visual imprint（视觉烙印）
scenes.speak: It's an industrial legacy used for over a hundred years. A visual imprint in the culture—we instinctively feel this is cinema.

practice: The 180-degree rule sets the shutter for the cinematic feel.
The eye's frame rate is dynamic, not fixed at 24fps.
Photoreceptor signals persist 1/10 to 1/15 of a second.
24fps came from the sound era, not the eye's limit.
A 180-degree opening gives the natural motion blur.
pitfalls: The eye's frame rate is dynamic and continuous.
Too-sharp frames break the motion illusion.
It's a human convention from film history—breakable.
It was chosen to fit sound and stable playback.
Confuse exposure time with sharpness alone.
Longer shutter means more motion blur, softer frames.
shifts: 用 180-degree rule（180度原则）、shutter angle（快门角度）、1/48s
用 persistence of vision（视觉暂留）、motion blur（动态模糊）、visual imprint（视觉烙印）
用 the industry's legacy（工业遗产）、natural blur（自然模糊）、frame rate reciprocal（帧率倒数）
